title: Distributed counterpower aversion and self-sealing sovereignty

source_basis.use: causal architecture, convergence mechanisms, evidentiary boundary, and falsifier basis
authority tiers, mainline waterline, namespace law, and build order

working_proposition: Self-sealing sovereignty can emerge as distributed counterpower aversion: separate actors with different ideologies and local objectives repeatedly preserve the protected center's freedom from binding correction.
negative_constitution: No external contradiction may become binding unless the protected center admits it on terms the center controls.

mechanisms.name: public_status_signaling
mechanisms.description: Funding, appointments, credentials, conferences, portfolios, service records, press, fellowships, and endorsements coordinate who is treated as a serious knower without a master list.
mechanisms.required_observation: one bounded public signal, audience, decision surface, and selection consequence
mechanisms.forbidden_inference: status signal proves communication, motive, or common purpose

mechanisms.name: personnel_routing
mechanisms.description: Conveners, translators, selectors, legitimizers, operators, and paper architects carry trust, vocabulary, threat models, evaluation heuristics, and institutional access across surfaces.
mechanisms.required_observation: named person, role, dates, endpoints, carried object or authority, and bounded consequence
mechanisms.forbidden_inference: career movement or co-presence proves coordination

mechanisms.name: compatible_interfaces
mechanisms.description: Capital, doctrine, procurement access, sensing, ontology, command workflow, communications, and public justification become functionally complementary while remaining legally and organizationally separate.
mechanisms.required_observation: named interface, data or authority flow, operating responsibility, dates, and alternative implementation
mechanisms.forbidden_inference: functional complementarity proves one legal organization or shared final blueprint

mechanisms.name: selection_effects
mechanisms.description: People and alternatives that resist the local objective are not funded, hired, promoted, published, invited, or retained; the surviving population then resembles consensus.
mechanisms.required_observation: complete eligible option or applicant denominator, decision rule, selected and rejected rows, and later survivor composition
mechanisms.forbidden_inference: absence from the survivor population proves incompetence or coordinated exclusion

mechanisms.name: counterfactual_foreclosure
mechanisms.description: Outside knowledge, failed bidders, public capacity, dissenting experts, and alternative architectures are removed before they can accumulate comparable receipts, and their absence is later presented as evidence that no credible alternative exists.
mechanisms.required_observation: named alternative, eligibility, blocked acquisition or trial route, missing comparison opportunity, and later necessity claim
mechanisms.forbidden_inference: missing alternative record alone proves deliberate foreclosure

cross_system_join.K0: epistemic admissibility and bounded contradiction-to-gate chain
cross_system_join.Clifford_C1_C7: problem definition, option formation, institutional conversion, infrastructure, dependency, retained authority or value, and correction
cross_system_join.POOF: functional integration projection subordinate to Clifford evidence; repository ecology remains a separate mainline reconciliation lane
cross_system_join.Answerable_Power_R0_R7: counterpower ladder from representation through value recovery
cross_system_join.Question_4_F0_F7: field experiment that can support or weaken the hypothesis through observed binding correction or failure

alternative_explanations: privacy, security, or safety restrictions with external adjudication
strategic deception or bypass where the contradiction was understood
professional specialization and bounded competence limits
independent local incentives without recurring correction suppression
